clara.evaluate_metric_v1.note: Wave E lane delta, the typed metric evaluator. DEPLOYED -- see the fs_pack note. The DB half (clara.verify_evaluator_freeze, run by migrate.mjs between every migration body and its commit) compares only rows flagged deployed, and both delta closures now are; this manifest must agree with that, because a deployed-vs-undeployed disagreement is exactly the gap an append-only lock cannot see across.

clara.evaluate_sst_watch.note: Wave A2.1 SST compliance-watch evaluator. LIVE on the project (0016 is applied), so its body is immutable vs origin/main forever. It predates clara.evaluator_versions and has no registry row; the DB-side verifier therefore says nothing about it and THIS manifest is its only freeze. That asymmetry is recorded rather than papered over: adding a retrospective registry row would be a claim about a deploy nobody made.

clara.evaluate_sst_watches_all.note: The all-clients driver beside evaluate_sst_watch; same LIVE status and the same recorded asymmetry.
